chapter: Zulu, Nice and the Punch Miller incident
title: Reaching Armstrong through manager Ira Mangle and Glazer
summary: To contact Armstrong you called Ira Mangle; Rose booked Nice via Glazer.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: He had a band manager whose name was Ira Mangle.

And when Louis was working anywhere in the country, and you wanted to communicate with him, of course you had to find out where he was staying. But if you knew where he was staying, you called Ira Mangle, and first of all that meant that you knew how to get to Louis. Yeah. And then Ira would take a message, and then Louis would call back.
If it was somebody he wanted to talk to.
If it was somebody he wanted to talk to, yeah. So anyway, that's when I called him about going to France for this thing in Nice, and he said, well, you've got to talk with Papa Joe, meaning Glazer.

And I said, yeah, I'll do that, but if I do that, and he says, okay, do you still want to go? He said, oh yeah. So that's what I did. I talked with Glazer and worked out the booking through him. The next time that I saw him in New Orleans was over that fiasco with Punch Miller, which I wrote about in I Remember Jazz.
